caption: Odense Canal, Odense
composition: A narrow canal, moored boats, and brick quay buildings · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From Havnegade, the Odense Canal is a narrow dark channel with a few small boats, brick quay buildings, and a low bridge farther along. The quay is empty. The afternoon is overcast, about 17.5°C.0°C. An overcast sky softens the afternoon light. The cathedral, the ochre lane, and the park lawns are not in this frame.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Odense canal in the afternoon, boats and brick warehouses
